description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム ZZ』より、パイロットスーツ姿の「プルツー」をFigure-rise Standardで立体化！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ ", " Purutsu" in a pilot suit is made into a figure-rise Standard!

description.ja: • 頭部はヘルメットやヘッドギアを装着可能。表情パーツの組み替えにも対応。
description.en: • A helmet or headgear can be attached to the head. Also supports rearrangement of facial parts.

description.ja: • ヘルメットのバイザーは着脱が可能。
• 胸部パーツは「襟元オープン状態」と「通常状態」の2種類付属。
description.en: • Two types of chest parts are included: "neck open state " and " normal state".

description.ja: • 表情はタンポ印刷済みパーツ1種と、水転写式デカール用パーツ2種で再現。
description.en: • The facial expressions are reproduced with one type of pad-printed part and two types of water transfer decal parts.

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ(タンポ印刷)×1種
accessories.en: Facial expression parts (tampo printing) x 1 type

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ(水転写式デカール)×2種
accessories.en: Facial expression parts (water transfer decal) x 2 types

accessories.ja: ヘッドギア付頭部パーツ×1
